version: C3 v3.8 research-only dip threshold and exposure controls
entry_execution: prior completed close triggers next session open
stop_take_anchor: original first fill; not moved after add
dip_floor: prior close >= 93% of initial open and above original stop
risk_budget_note: Comparisons do not equalize maximum exposure; cash control isolates initial cash effect only.
limitations: Reused historical sample and multiple correlated scenarios
Daily OHLCV cannot resolve intraday order
A stop intraday on the add day is not simulated after opening add; results may be optimistic.
